findings.claim: NetApp FY2026 10-K 風險揭露：自進口來源國採購／製造的產品，若貿易限制、關稅或稅負變動，可能對業務與財務結果造成重大不利影響；美國關稅政策仍在變動，另有中美緊張與台海風險可能影響關鍵零組件取得。
findings.source: NetApp, Inc. Form 10-K FY2026 (period ended 2026-04-24), SEC EDGAR
findings.excerpt: changes in trade restrictions, tariffs, or taxes on imports from countries where they source and/or manufacture products could have a material adverse effect on their business and financial results.

findings.claim: 報導稱美中同意對 300 億美元商品降關稅並啟動 AI 對話（2026-09-27）。
findings.source: The National: China and US agree to tariff cuts on $30 billion in goods and AI dialogue
findings.excerpt: China and US agree to tariff cuts on $30 billion in goods and AI dialogue

findings.claim: 產業層：IEEPA 關稅遭最高法院否決後，10% 全球關稅於 2026-07-24 到期，改為對 80 國課 10–12.5% 的 Section 301 關稅；IT 硬體成本 2026 年上升 15–30%。此為一般產業資料，非 NetApp 專屬。
findings.source: WebSearch 摘要（growrk.com 等）：data storage hardware tariff exposure supply chain 2026
findings.excerpt: Global IT hardware costs are up 15-30% in 2026, with tariffs and AI demand creating a structural price surge.
